resources.string: Prepare cuts and listen to each slice before applying. Original audio and PADs stay intact. After applying, assign any slice to a PAD.
This range is too short. Widen it or reduce the slice count or minimum spacing.
No cuts found. Check for silence or sustained sound, lower the minimum level, or choose equal slices.
Too many cuts. Adjust minimum spacing, minimum level, or maximum slices. Existing cuts are unchanged.
Audio memory is full. Stop playback and try again.
Wait for the current operation to finish.
Finish recording, then reopen auto chop.
The project changed. Reopen auto chop.
Could not prepare cuts or preview. Check the audio and output.
The estimate follows this output. It is not a measured round-trip latency. Settings reset when the output, format, buffer or clock changes.
Larger values move the cut earlier. Adjust the total delay while listening, in 1 ms steps. This setting lasts for this output session.
Timing changed. The pass ended and its correction was reset.
Timing is unavailable. Choose a manual total delay or reopen the output.
The document changed. This pass ended without applying the old press.
